mods.name: Portal Mod Extras
mods.description:
Did you tested the famous §lPortalMod §rmod but theres things that you wanted but heres no in the mod? Well... We present you...
§lPortalMod Extra§r!
This mod add a lot of things that the community wanted like:

§lLaser:
§r§a§lLaser Emitter §r& §d§lLaser Receiver §rwith a particle-made §4§cLaser Beam§r! The laser emitter can be enabled & disabled with §bAntline Indicator§r, and when the laser receiver receive the laser, he can power on the §bAntline §raround him.

§lPortal Gun Pedestal:
§rThe §a§lPortal Gun Pedestal §ris here to take the §d§lPortal Gun §rlike in §lPortal 1§r! And don't worry! The portal gun when picked-out have the same §bData §rthan before (uuid, data, portal's link, colors) !

Theres much more in the mod so go discover it!

§cWe are not affiliated with PortalMod or Minecraft or Mojang. And, the mod need the real one to have hi's full functionnality (but he can work without)

§f§lCredits:
Thanks to LeVraiRayan for creating the mod, MG for the aperture science glass texture, Mylo for the fixed Portal Gun Pedestal size, AxolotlKirill for helping to the redirection cube, Lemo for doing new & better textures, Mr Ant Tenna for turret redemption line texture... But also to 乃のの丂ｲ乇尺乃ﾑ爪, NullASilly, MG, Mr Ant Tenna, Glados|Foxy, Xoko_Man, Mylo, maybejahmess, portalqwest1886, mineno david, daxiKing_, Jah, PheonX, Crinchy, BBench for every suggestions they give! But also to you user! To playing the mod!
